what: Deployment strategy for aide-memory npm releases: 1) Tag a version: git tag v0.2.0, 2) Push tag: git push origin v0.2.0, 3) GitHub Actions workflow (.github/workflows/release.yml) auto-runs: builds, tests, swaps package.aide-memory.json → package.json, publishes to npm using NPM_TOKEN secret, creates GitHub Release. NPM_TOKEN is configured in aide-memory/aide-memory repo secrets (added April 2026). Manual alternative: npm login, cp package.aide-memory.json package.json, npm publish --access public, git checkout package.json.
why: User asked to document deployment strategy so it persists across sessions. Critical for consistent releases.
